name: io.endos/endos-mcp
title: Endos MCP
description: Connect your team to any MCP tool with verified execution and commerce infrastructure for AI agents.

tools.name: endos_get_status
tools.description: Gives one summary of this agent's protection in Endos, the checkpoint between the agent and the owner's tools: whether the owner approved the agent, which protections are on and in what mode, how many held items wait for the owner's decision, and when the last tool list was taken and how many tools it found; in the Local Helper, also the state of each local connection. Suited to a first check after setup or after an unexpected refusal; endos_list_held_items lists the held items one by one, and endos_list_connections shows each connection by id. Takes no input. Online, it does not test the connections again at that moment, and it shows settings only as on or off, modes and counts, never addresses, keys or amounts.

tools.name: endos_list_held_items
tools.description: Lists this agent's holds that wait for the owner's decision, one line per hold, newest first, of each kind Endos holds: a tool call that needs approval, a call to a destination the owner has not approved yet, or a tool or connection that changed since approval. Each line gives when it was held, when the hold expires, why, and its hold id; limit sets how many are shown (default 20, up to 50). Suited to seeing what still waits after Endos held a call; endos_list_changed_tools names only the changed tools, by connection id, and endos_explain_refusal gives the full reason for one call from its call id (a hold id is a different number). Only the owner can approve or refuse an item, on the Endos dashboard; this tool cannot release anything. It never shows call content, and says so when nothing is waiting.

limit.description: How many held items to show, newest first (1 to 50, default 20).

tools.name: endos_check_before_sending
tools.description: Runs Endos's outgoing check on text the agent plans to send, without sending it, and answers allowed, or refused with each category found (for example an email address or a key) and a hint on what to change. Suited to checking a message or document before a call that may be refused; endos_explain_refusal covers a call that was already refused. A connection id from endos_list_connections applies that connection's own settings for email addresses, names and handles. It sends nothing to any connected service, does not store the text, writes no call record, and Endos limits how often it can be used. Allowed is not a promise: a real call gets other checks too, so it may still be refused or held.

text.description: The exact text the agent plans to send, for example a message or document body; up to 100,000 characters. It is checked, never sent or stored.

connection.description: Optional: the connection id that endos_list_connections shows, to apply that connection's rules.

tools.name: endos_explain_refusal
tools.description: Explains why Endos refused, held or withheld one of this agent's calls: the outcome, the category found and what to change when Endos recorded one, and for a refusal whether the owner can allow that kind of call. Refused means Endos stopped the call; held means it waits for the owner's decision; withheld means the tool answered but Endos kept the answer back; if Endos could not check a call, it says so. Suited to the moment after a refusal or a hold; Endos's refused, held and withheld answers show the call id. endos_get_cleaning_report covers what was removed from an answer, and a call that went through is reported as not refused. It never shows the blocked value, and says when it has no call with that id (unknown, expired or another agent's).

call_id.description: The call id that Endos's answer showed for the call (refused, held, withheld or cleaned answers show one).

tools.name: endos_get_cleaning_report
tools.description: Shows what Endos removed from a tool's answer before the agent got it, for one of this agent's calls (a withheld answer included), as counts by category (for example hidden instructions, secrets, tracking data or personal details), or that nothing was removed. A cleaned answer still reaches the agent, with those parts taken out and a note from Endos that carries the call id. Suited to an answer that looks shortened or changed; endos_explain_refusal covers why a call was refused or held. It never shows the removed text or the original answer, and says when it has no call with that id (unknown, expired or another agent's).

call_id.description: The call id that Endos's answer showed for the call (refused, held, withheld or cleaned answers show one).

tools.name: endos_list_connections
tools.description: Lists the services connected behind Endos for this agent, with each connection's id and, for one that listed, how many tools it showed and the names of its usable tools: the ones the last tool list showed this agent, so not held, hidden or refused. Online, it shows whether each one worked at the last check and does not test it again; in the Local Helper, whether each one is running, stopped or could not start, or is refused or held. Suited to a tool that seems missing or a connection that fails, and to finding the connection id that endos_check_before_sending and endos_list_changed_tools accept; endos_list_changed_tools names the held changed tools, and endos_get_status gives one summary of the whole setup. Takes no input, and shows no addresses or keys.

tools.name: endos_list_changed_tools
tools.description: Lists the tool definitions that changed, or are new, since the owner approved them, which Endos holds until the owner looks at them again, by connection id and tool name: names only, since Endos does not keep earlier tool descriptions and so cannot show what changed. A connection id from endos_list_connections narrows it to that connection. A changed tool is one whose description or input schema differs from what the owner approved, and the agent cannot use it while it is held. Suited to a tool used before that is no longer available; endos_list_held_items lists the holds of each kind, these included, with when each expires and its hold id. Only the owner can release a tool, on the dashboard; this tool cannot release anything.

connection.description: Optional: the connection id that endos_list_connections shows, to show that connection's tools only.
